comment: What the real `datum tail` prints for the `log` sequence below — the CLI half of
the tail-parity assertion in tests/seam.test.mjs. Regenerate with `npm run
test:fixtures` (needs a built `datum` binary); `log` is authored by hand and
Hids are masked (support/tail.mjs) because they are minted per write. Every
other character — the header, the column order, the alignment, the `_n`
ordinals, the clock — is compared exactly. Every row is logged at an absolute
clock time TODAY, so the table a capture in one timezone-pinned run produces is
the table the browser produces in another.
table:
